title: Why Drink Water In The Morning

vo.text: Eight hours. No food. No water.
Every night, your body keeps losing water —
just breathing, just sweating, even at rest.
No food or drink to replace it, for eight straight hours.
Guess how much water you lose, just sleeping.
humid air breathed out, sweat off your skin.
That's the mild dehydration you wake up with.
Drink about a glass first thing,
and resting metabolism can spike up to thirty percent —
peaking within the hour, then fading.
Not a wellness trend. Just replacing what you lost.
